from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class IFCFinancialDataFY24:

    A dataclass representing key financial highlights of the International Finance 
    Corporation (IFC) for Fiscal Year 2024 (ended June 30, 2024).
    
    All base figures are stored in millions of USD, consistent with the reporting 
    currency and precision used in the IFC 2024 Annual Report financial statements.
    
    Citations:
    - Net income: IFC 2024 Annual Report Financial Statements, Page 64, Consolidated Statements of Operations.
    - Total assets: IFC 2024 Annual Report Financial Statements, Page 63, Consolidated Balance Sheets.
    """
    fiscal_year: str = "FY24"
    
    # Net Income (Loss) for the year ended June 30, 2024 is $1,485 million ($1.485 billion).
    # Source: IFC 2024 Annual Report Financial Statements, Page 64, Consolidated Statements of Operations.
    net_income_usd_millions: int = 1485
    
    # Total Assets as of June 30, 2024 is $108,187 million ($108.187 billion).
    # Source: IFC 2024 Annual Report Financial Statements, Page 63, Consolidated Balance Sheets.
    total_assets_usd_millions: int = 108187

    @property
    def net_income_usd_billions(self) -> float:
        """Returns the net income in billions of US dollars (USD)."""
        return self.net_income_usd_millions / 1000.0

    @property
    def total_assets_usd_billions(self) -> float:
        """Returns the total assets in billions of US dollars (USD)."""
        return self.total_assets_usd_millions / 1000.0
